description.narrative: The proposed project will enhance the coverage and improve the reliability and efficiency of the transmission and distribution network, to facilitate better utilization of the expanding power generation capacity to meet the growth in electricity demand across the country

description.narrative: Access to efficient and reliable electricity supply in Bangladesh improved

About 1,100,000 new connections, including 1,025,000 rural households, connected to electricity network and benefiting at least 875,000 women (2016 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Ongoing. Total 943,170 new connections have been provided by BREB. Data Source: Annual reports of BREB Actual value:
At least 68,727 tons of carbon emissions are avoided every year (2016 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: On going. Data Source: Annual report of BREB and PSMP Actual value:
Rural distribution losses reduced to 9.0% (2016 baseline: Losses at 12.5%) Progress/Status: System loss is 8.16% by June 2024. Data Source: Annual reports of BREB Actual value:

Average system interruption duration index for BREB decreased by at least 22% (2015 baseline: 1,990 minutes based on planned interruptions for 11 kV feeders) Progress/Status: System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI) is 1,233 minutes for FY 2019, decreased by 38.04%. Data Source: Annual reports of BREB Target value: -20% Actual value:
Transmission losses reduced to 2.5% (2016 baseline: 3.0%) Progress/Status: PGCB target. Overall transmission loss is 2.6%. Data Source: Annual reports of PGCB Actual value:

Average system interruption duration index for DESCO-operated part of Dhaka city decreased by at least 25% (2015 baseline: 646 minutes) Progress/Status: DESCO target achieved. System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI) is 394.01 which is decreased by 38.85%. Data Source: Annual reports of DESCO Target value: -25% Actual value:

Tariffs reviewed annually and reset to increasingly cover costs of transmission and distribution utilities as per approved regulations (2016 baseline: Occasional tariff reviews are not based on approved regulations) Progress/Status: Complied. All utilities submitted their application to increase tariff in Nov 2019. BERC approved the tariff revision in February 2024. Data Source: Annual reports of PGCB, DESCO, and BREB Base year: 2016 Baseline value: N
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Distribution network in rural areas of Bangladesh including the capacity of end-users improved Indicator: More than 38,000 km of 33 kV and 11 kV distribution lines and associated facilities rehabilitated (Baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Till now, 28,777 km 33 and 11 kV distribution lines and associated facilities has been rehabilitated. Data Source: Annual reports of BREB and PBSs Actual value:

Output: Capacity in power sector agencies enhanced Indicator: Detailed engineering reports for four projects completed (Baseline: 0) Progress/Status: 2 studies are ongoing for 4 solar and wind project development. Data Source: Review reports from Power Cell Actual value:

Output: Capacity in power sector agencies enhanced Indicator: Measures to attract more women employees in at least five PBSs in place . (Baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Consulting firm is recruited under Grant 9190. Women friendly measures and activities are ongoing. Data Source: Review reports from BREB and PBSs Actual value:

Output: Distribution network in rural areas of Bangladesh including the capacity of end-users improved Indicator: 200 people trained on energy-based livelihoods with at least 30% women and 50 small businesses, including 50% led by women entrepreneurs, supported (Baseline: 0) Progress/Status: 351 BPL consumers including 35% women already trained on selected business. Data Source: Annual reports of BREB and PBSs Actual value:

Output: Distribution network in rural areas of Bangladesh including the capacity of end-users improved Indicator: At least 1,000 end-users (at least 40% women) trained on safe and efficient use of energy (Baseline: 0) Progress/Status: 1585 newly electrified consumer already trained on safe, efficient & productive use of electricity Data Source: Annual reports of BREB and PBSs Actual value:

Output: Distribution network in rural areas of Bangladesh including the capacity of end-users improved Indicator: Over 15,990 km of 33 kV and 11 kV distribution lines and associated facilities with EWCD designs constructed (Baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Till now, 11,388 km 33 and 11 kV distribution lines and associated facilities constructed . Data Source: Annual reports of BREB and PBSs Actual value:

Output: National transmission network in southern Bangladesh strengthened Indicator: About 174 km of 400 kV transmission lines and associated facilities constructed Progress/Status: Completed. Data Source: Annual Reports of PGCB Actual value:

Output: Capacity in power sector agencies enhanced Indicator: Capital expenditure investment and tariff petitions by transmission and distribution utilities in accordance with approved tariff regulations annually submitted. (Baseline: Occasional filing) Progress/Status: Tariff petition has been annually submitted by PGCB, DESCO and BREB . Data Source: Tariff filing petitions received by the Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: n Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: n Target year: 2025 Target value: y

Progress/Status: GIS mapping scope is being implemented for NESCO. Consultant recruitment process is ongoing under Loan 3523. BREB's GIS scope is being implemented under World Bank financing.
